value.rationale: The full natural 1728-element symmetry of a canonical mixed-alphabet Hamming metric Rips complex is mathematically motivated and its 14 distinct irreducible components cannot be recovered from the previously known wedge-of-96-spheres homotopy type. The character also answers the natural full-symmetry quotient homology question and gives an exact 45-class representation benchmark for an all-nonbinary mixed-alphabet model.
